title: CutoverOutput
description: Output schema for the go-anything cutover command.

unit_id.description: Migration unit identifier targeted by the cutover command.

kill_switch_active.description: Whether the kill switch is currently engaged for this unit or globally.

target_service.description: Active target service or binary receiving production traffic.

fallback_count.description: Cumulative count of automatic fallback invocations back to the legacy original.

fallbacks.description: Cumulative count of automatic fallback invocations back to the legacy original (alias).

warnings.description: Safety warnings or prerequisite advisories (e.g. active fallback traffic, unverified unit).
